name: Prince Azor
description: From a soft, smoky little fluff ball into a striking full-grown male, Prince Azor has developed into a cat with real presence. His high blue smoke colouring has become more defined with age, giving him a cool, elegant look that suits his calm and confident nature. As a kitten, he already showed lovely expression and strong features, and those qualities have matured beautifully over time. This progression offers a clear glimpse of how a Maine Coon can change from a fluffy youngster into a composed, impressive adult.
